description:
One branch that becomes the single flip PR (folds former dlv2-20, -21, -30, -40, -41). Branch from #2444's branch (fix/dev-loop-v2-soundness-hold), which already adds .github/workflows/ci.yml with a `tooling` soundness-flag job and .github/soundness-paths.txt; rebase onto develop if #2444 merges first.
ci.yml:
- on: pull_request (NO branches filter) and merge_group.
- classify job: .github/ci-units.yml path map (core: benchbox/, tests/, _sources/, _binaries/, pyproject.toml, uv.lock; explorer: results-explorer/; results-data: results-data/; docs: docs/; landing: landing/; tooling: scripts/, _project/scripts/, .github/, Makefile, make/, .pre-commit-config.yaml). Widened: explorer also on benchbox/core/results/** and results-data/**; docs also on benchbox/cli/** and registries; landing also on PlatformRegistry/dependency groups. Unknown paths -> all units. Diff base: PR base SHA or merge_group.base_sha. Extend scripts/path_filter_decision.py (reuse).
- Six result jobs named exactly core, explorer, results-data, docs, landing, tooling; if: always(); fail on any failed/cancelled dependency; pass when untouched.
- core on pull_request (T1): lint, types, unit tests sharded (reuse existing pytest invocations/markers; the 0.5 s budget and durations from #2443 are optional here), offline adapter tests as they exist. core on merge_group (T2, JOB BUDGET <=8 Linux jobs total): all unit tests (sharded), required engine cases duckdb tpch+tpcds, datafusion tpch, polars-df tpch with a no-skip guard, correctness gate + oracle checks (Linux), wheel+sdist build + sha256 + artifact upload keyed by SHA (retention 90 days), Linux wheel install smoke with dbgen/dsdgen, check_dependency_bounds.py. macOS/Windows install and extra Python versions go to nightly/T4, not T2.
- explorer: vitest, typecheck, build, chromium e2e. docs/landing: build, and the public-site visual comparison ONLY when docs/landing paths are affected (the legacy visual check failed merge groups of unrelated PRs). results-data: submission validator + explorer contract. tooling: lint, soundness flag, workflow tests (test_workflow_context_availability; a new test asserting no branch filter, merge_group present, all result jobs if: always()), and scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py against the POST-FLIP expected settings.
Deletions in the same branch: .github/workflows/{pr.yml, publication-lane-docs.yml, publication-lane-explorer.yml, results-explorer-browser.yml, gitignore-lint.yml, pr-base-guard.yml, auto-merge-on-open.yml, develop-ruleset-drift.yml, develop-post-merge.yml, develop-post-merge-gap-detector.yml, develop-refresh-shadow.yml, orphaned-commit-detector.yml, soundness-drain.yml, phase3-promotion-review.yml, extension-smoke.yml}; docs.yml: remove pull_request/merge_group triggers and PR-gate jobs but KEEP its push-to-develop Pages deploy until dlv2-62. Tests that only assert deleted workflows' structure are deleted; tests guarding kept properties are retargeted to ci.yml (ledger rows updated).
Also in the branch: drift expected settings (docs/operations/repo-admin-settings.md) describing the post-flip ruleset; AGENTS.md and .claude/commands/pr.md updated for the new checks (pr-base-guard/stacked-PR text, soundness review, no develop-post-merge); ADR amendment replacing G1 (20 green runs) and G2 (5-day shadow) with: canary PR set before the flip and 3 green queue merges after it.
Release-branch workflows (test.yml, lint.yml, perf-smoke.yml, validate-release-pr.yml, release-canary.yml, release.yml) and all scheduled/publication workflows are NOT touched.
